_doc: Pinned toolchain for HyperFrames rendering. `engine doctor` checks it; `engine doctor --install` installs missing or mismatched components into vendor/. Installed trees are gitignored. node: one `version`, plus url and sha256 of the official tarball per platform key (linux-x64, darwin-arm64); the hashes come from https://nodejs.org/dist/<version>/SHASUMS256.txt. chrome: @puppeteer/browsers picks the platform build for the same version.
